```{python}
#| echo: false

# GENERATED FROM THIS CHAPTER'S OWN _model.py (rule 35 keeps this block here).
# The fork header is the one place the parent is recorded; printing it here means
# a reader sees the lineage without opening the collapsed source, and it cannot
# drift from the file it is read out of.
import pathlib as _pl
import re as _re
_hdr = (_pl.Path("chapters/02-fuselage-model/_model.py").read_text()[:2000]
        if _pl.Path("chapters/02-fuselage-model/_model.py").exists() else "")
_fk = _re.search(r"^#\s*Forked from chapters/([^/\s]+)/_model\.py", _hdr, _re.M)
if _fk:
    _par = _pl.Path("chapters") / _fk.group(1) / "index.qmd"
    _pt = _re.search(r'^title:\s*"(.+)"\s*$', _par.read_text(), _re.M) \
        if _par.exists() else None
    print(f"Forked from [{_pt.group(1) if _pt else _fk.group(1)}]"
          f"(../{_fk.group(1)}/) — what differs is listed at the top of "
          f"`_model.py` below.\n")
```
